outputs.explanation: Panel a is a schematic/micrograph illustrating image cropping, rotation and resizing; it is not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel b is a schematic/micrograph illustrating image spacing; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel c is a schematic/micrograph showing zoom/inset presentation; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel d is a micrograph series illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel e is a schematic/micrograph illustrating channel annotation visibility; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel f is a schematic/micrograph illustrating grayscale channel display; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel g is a schematic/micrograph with calibration/intensity scale bars; no plot of averaged data (e.g., bar chart) is present, so individual data points are not applicable.
